responsibility: Defines the ISO interface for accessing and redirecting standard and default channels. It declares functions for the implementation-provided standard input, output, error, and null channels, separate accessors for the current default input/output/error channels, and setters that let programs redirect those defaults while continuing to use the standard-channel convenience modules.
same_name_distinction: This .def file defines only the ISO-visible API for retrieving standard/default channels and redirecting defaults, while StdChans.mod contains the concrete mapping of FIO standard files into channel devices and the mutable state for current defaults.
